meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索过去所有会话中保存的记录。当你询问之前的工作时，它会先返回候选列表，再按你的选择读取完整详情。
howto.when: 当用户提及之前的会话，例如问“这个之前解决过吗？”、“上次 X 是怎么做的？”，或需要查找历次工作内容时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录超时问题的？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关记录并列出结果。

say.text: 之前有没有讨论过数据备份方案？
say.note: Claude 会返回匹配的历史记录。
Claude 会按类型搜索并呈现列表。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search records saved across past sessions. When you ask about earlier work, it first returns a candidate list, then reads full details based on your selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user refers to previous sessions, e.g., asking "did we already fix this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needing work from earlier sessions.

say_en.text: How did we solve the login timeout issue last time?
say_en.note: Claude will search related records and list results.

say_en.text: Did we ever discuss a data backup plan?
say_en.note: Claude will return matching historical records.

say_en.text: Which bugs did I fix last week?
say_en.note: Claude will search by type and present the list.
